name: Koumyouji Gaku
source:
A boy with a serious personality.

He is a blunt and naive person who thinks that Fronte's favors are nothing more than friendship, but he unconsciously makes advances on Fronte. He is a bit of a germophobe and likes to clean. He is a little concerned about his baby face and short stature. 

He has a deep respect for his father.

[Translated from [url=http://frontemagica.starfree.jp/amoluce/]official website[/url]]
